greet.speaker: The Wraith
greet.text: You still have [flicker]colour[/flicker] in you. How quaint. Down here that fades fast.

who.speaker: The Wraith
who.text: A light that stopped drawing. I forgot my own line, and the dark filled the rest.

deeper.speaker: The Wraith
deeper.text: Follow the ink that runs [shake]downhill[/shake]. And do not let your hand go still.

leave.speaker: The Wraith
leave.text: Go on, then. The deep is patient. It will have your colour soon enough.
